name: Addison M2 HSS Jobber Twist Drill Bits Industrial Set
shortDescription: M2 grade High-Speed Steel parallel shank twist drill bits with 118° split point and ground flutes for precision hole drilling in mild steel, cast iron, and alloys.
overview: Addison is India's premier brand in industrial metal cutting tools, renowned for uncompromising metallurgy and manufacturing accuracy. This M2 grade High Speed Steel (HSS) jobber drill bit series is ground from solid bar stock with steam-tempered black oxide finish to minimize friction and resist built-up edge formation. Featuring a self-centering 118-degree split point angle that bites immediately into workpiece surfaces without walking, it produces clean, burr-free cylindrical holes in carbon steels, cast iron, bronze, brass, and structural alloys.
keyFeatures: Manufactured from premium M2 High Speed Steel (AISI M2 / DIN 1.3343)
Fully ground flutes (DIN 338 / IS 5101) ensure optimal chip evacuation and concentricity
118° self-centering split point eliminates center punching on flat metal sheets
Steam-tempered black oxide surface treatment retains cutting fluid and dissipates heat
Hardened cutting edges (63 – 65 HRC) withstand high cutting speeds without blunting
Parallel straight shank compatible with all standard keyed and keyless chucks
High torsional rigidity prevents bit breakage during breakthrough on thin plates
applications: General engineering workshop machining and lathe drilling
Structural steel girder, flange, and gusset plate fabrication
Electrical control panel enclosure drilling and tapping preparation
Automotive repair, cylinder block drilling, and precision reaming prep
packageContents: 1x Set of Addison HSS Jobber Drill Bits (Protective Metal Index Case)
